input.rationale: Article VIX supplies the Licensed Technology wholly "AS IS" and disclaims all warranties "WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED", including merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, accuracy and title, and expressly negates any commitment that errors or nonconformity to the Documentation will be corrected. No affirmative performance or conformance warranty exists elsewhere in the Agreement: the closest obligation is Article VII(f), under which Licensor uses "commercially reasonable efforts" to provide Error Corrections, which is a support undertaking rather than a warranty and carries no repair, replace or refund remedy. That is the rule's walk-away position (AS IS with all warranties disclaimed and no conformance warranty) and falls short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). The redline inserts a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 12-month conformance-to-Documentation warranty, no-malicious-code and compliance-with-laws warranties, and a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carves those express warranties out of the disclaimer; the comment offers the 90/30-day fallback.

proposal.summary: Carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer and add an affirmative performance/conformance warranty with a repair, replace or refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently supplied wholly "AS IS" with every express and implied warranty disclaimed, so we have no contractual recourse if the Platform fails to work as documented. We have added a standard performance and conformance warranty (12 months for software, professional and workmanlike services, no malicious code, compliance with law) with a repair, replace or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer. If a shorter period is needed we can accept 90 days for the software and 30 days for the support services with the same remedies.
